sectionTitle: Why SCIMEE is the First Choice for Medical Aspirants
sectionSubtitle: A disciplined learning ecosystem combining cutting-edge testing, personalized mentorship, and dedicated study infrastructure.

items.title: Dedicated Library & Quiet Reading Room
items.description: Distraction-free environment with individual study desks, reference books, NCERT exhaustive modules, and extended operating hours for self-study and deep revision.

items.title: Experienced Faculty for Each Subject
items.description: Specialist educators dedicated to Physics, Chemistry, and Biology who break down complex numericals and biological processes into intuitive, easily memorable concepts.

items.title: Weekly OMR Test Series & Error Analysis
items.description: Strict examination hall simulation with optical mark recognition (OMR) sheets, negative marking drills, and question-by-question post-test postmortems.

items.title: Special 1-on-1 Attention on Each Student
items.description: Small cohort sizes allowing teachers to pinpoint individual student weaknesses, clarify doubts on demand, and craft customized improvement roadmaps.

items.title: Continuous Interaction with Parents
items.description: Regular performance updates, attendance monitoring, and parent-teacher counseling sessions to keep families aligned and motivated throughout the NEET journey.

items.title: Transparent & Reasonable Fee Structure
items.description: High-standard national-level medical coaching made affordable for all deserving students in Bhusawal, Jalgaon, and Khandesh region without hidden costs.
